migration.lineageNote: Measured 2026-09-05 with git merge-base --is-ancestor on complete history: v1.0.0 (2629c71, 2026-07-26) is a strict ANCESTOR of the owned fork. Upstream master 9a89ff3 (2026-08-12) descends from the tag (325 commits later), and the owned fork HEAD 26f1d62 is upstream master plus two local commits (1 file, +10/-2). The npm-published 1.0.0 tag is therefore older than the code the owned runtime already ships; adopting it would be a downgrade, not an upgrade. An earlier unrelated-histories record here was an artifact of a stale .git/shallow boundary at 9a89ff3 in the nested clone and has been corrected with a deterministic probe guard.
migration.disposition: evaluated, not adopted; this manifest maps the static seam only and changes no runtime code

capabilityNote: This manifest records the static migration seam only. It does not claim BOLT-WC-005 or BOLT-WC-006 compatibility; both remain blocked pending real Chrome E2E proof.

seam.note: Candidate BootOptions are {compress, serviceWorkerUrl, workerName, devtools}; the adapter contract boots with {signal, previewOrigin, coep, workdirName, forwardPreviewErrors}. No option overlaps, so the adapter loader must translate or reject.
No AbortSignal on boot; adapter boot cancellation cannot be forwarded.
Preview routing is fixed to the same-origin Service Worker; adapter previewOrigin cannot be honored.
Candidate FileSystemAPI covers the adapter file methods; readdir(withFileTypes) additionally exists.
No watcher API; adapter fs.watch and the fs-change event have no candidate backing.
mountPoint is honored; the AbortSignal option does not exist in the candidate signature.
cwd/env are forwarded by the candidate; the AbortSignal option is absent (cancellation only via process kill()).
Candidate preview is previewUrl(port)/server-ready plus a same-origin Service Worker; there is no iframe attach/detach API for the adapter to call.
Event names match the adapter seam; the candidate error payload is {message}, so the adapter must wrap it in an Error.
Candidate event map has no fs-change member.
No filesystem export API on the candidate instance.
Candidate teardown() is synchronous and clears listeners plus the kernel bridge.
Candidate merges stdout+stderr into one ReadableStream<string>, matching the adapter's merged-output handling.
No separate stdout/stderr streams exist on VivariProcess.
SIGTERM-equivalent posting proc-kill; exit still resolves.
VivariProcess exposes no pid; the adapter contract requires one and has no honest source for it on this candidate.
